snippet.title: Nintendo Presents: New Style Boutique (Trailer) - Nintendo 3DS
snippet.description:
Test your fashion sense, manage your own boutique and take the fashion world by storm!

Taking on the role of assistant at a local fashion store in town, it's down to you to work your way up to the coveted position of boutique owner, influencing style all over town and shining brightly under the spotlights of the catwalk.

If you think you have what it takes to storm the fashion world, then get creative and show your keen eye for fashion and knack for good business when Nintendo presents: New Style Boutique launches across Europe on 16th November.

Free demo available now via the Nintendo eShop - internet connection required.
